description: End-to-end change management workflow for prepaid telco charging, covering offer migration, balance adjustments, policy changes, and rollback handling.

subscriber_id.description: Unique subscriber identifier (e.g., MSISDN or CRM ID)

change_request_id.description: Identifier for a specific change request in the charging system

charging_profile_id.description: Identifier of a charging profile (tariff plan, price plan, or offer set)

offer_id.description: Identifier for a commercial offer or package

policy_id.description: Identifier for a charging or rating policy

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code (e.g., MYR, USD, EUR)

actor_info.description: Information about the user or system initiating the change

actor_id.description: Identifier of the actor (employee ID, system name, etc.)

ip_address.description: IP address of the originating channel

functions.name: get_subscriber_charging_context
functions.description: Retrieve the current charging context for a subscriber including balances, active offers, and charging profile.

include.description: Additional sections to include in the response

as_of_time.description: Point in time for which context is requested; defaults to now

functions.returns: Comprehensive charging context for the subscriber including current balances, active offers, charging profile, and any pending change requests.

functions.name: search_charging_profiles
functions.description: Search and filter available charging profiles and offers that a subscriber can migrate to.

query.description: Free-text search on charging profile or offer name/description

filters.description: Filter criteria for eligible charging profiles

valid_for_migration.description: Whether only migration-eligible profiles should be returned

min_balance_required.description: Minimum main balance required to migrate

functions.returns: List of charging profiles and/or offers available to the subscriber, including basic pricing and eligibility indicators.

functions.name: evaluate_charging_change_impact
functions.description: Simulate and evaluate the impact of a prospective charging change (e.g., tariff migration, balance adjustment) before submitting a change request.

proposed_changes.description: Set of proposed changes to evaluate

effective_time.description: Desired effective time for this action

amount.description: Positive to credit, negative to debit

reason_code.description: Internal code describing the adjustment reason

simulation_horizon_hours.description: Number of hours to simulate forward usage and charging impact

functions.returns: Impact analysis including estimated cost changes, balance evolutions, eligibility checks, and risk assessment for the proposed changes.

functions.name: create_charging_change_request
functions.description: Create a new change request for a subscriber's charging configuration, including profile migration, offer actions, and balance adjustments.

payload.description: Detailed specification of the requested change

offers.description: Offer-level actions as part of the request

parameters.description: Optional parameters specific to the offer action

reference.description: External reference (e.g., dispute ID, promo ID)

policy_overrides.description: Requested temporary or permanent charging policy overrides

parameters.description: Key-value parameters to override, schema is policy-specific

execution_window.description: Execution timing for scheduled or windowed modes

client_metadata.description: Arbitrary client metadata for auditing and correlation

functions.returns: A newly created change_request_id with initial status, validation results, and any required next actions (e.g., approval).

functions.name: validate_charging_change_request
functions.description: Run pre-execution validations on a charging change request to check eligibility, conflicts, and policy constraints.

deep_validation.description: If true, performs more intensive cross-system validation checks

validation_scopes.description: Select specific validation scopes to run

functions.returns: Validation outcome including pass/fail status per scope, detailed errors/warnings, and whether the change can proceed to execution.

functions.name: approve_or_reject_charging_change
functions.description: Approve or reject a pending charging change request as part of the governance workflow.

reason.description: Explanation for the decision, mandatory for rejection

conditions.description: Conditional constraints attached to the approval

functions.returns: Updated approval state of the change request, including audit trail of the decision and any conditions applied.

functions.name: execute_charging_change_request
functions.description: Execute an approved and validated charging change request, updating balances, offers, policies, and charging profiles.

max_runtime_seconds.description: Maximum allowed execution time before marking as timed_out

dry_run.description: If true, simulates execution steps without committing changes

functions.returns: Execution result including per-step outcomes, final status of the change request, and any generated rollback tokens or audit references.

functions.name: get_charging_change_status
functions.description: Retrieve the current status and history of a charging change request.

history_limit.description: Maximum number of history events to return

functions.returns: Current status, progress metrics, and history timeline of the change request, optionally including related context and audit information.

functions.name: cancel_charging_change_request
functions.description: Request cancellation of a pending or scheduled charging change request before it is fully executed.

force.description: If true, attempt to cancel even if execution has partially started

functions.returns: Cancellation outcome including whether the request was successfully cancelled, partially cancelled, or could not be cancelled, with appropriate reasons.

functions.name: retry_failed_charging_change
functions.description: Retry execution of a failed or partially failed charging change request with optional overrides.

custom_step_ids.description: List of step identifiers to retry when retry_mode is custom_steps

override_parameters.description: Overrides for specific parameters that caused earlier failures

functions.returns: Retry execution plan and updated status of the change request, including new attempt identifiers and any steps skipped due to idempotency checks.

functions.name: rollback_charging_change
functions.description: Perform a rollback of a previously executed charging change, restoring balances, offers, and charging profile where possible.
functions.returns: Rollback plan and outcome including which elements were successfully reverted, any residual inconsistencies, and resulting subscriber charging context.

functions.name: list_charging_change_requests
functions.description: List change requests for a subscriber or across the system with filtering and pagination.

time_range.description: Filter change requests by creation time

initiated_by_actor_id.description: Filter by actor who initiated the change

functions.returns: Paginated list of change requests matching the filters, including basic metadata and current status for each request.

functions.name: audit_charging_change_discrepancy
functions.description: Audit and reconcile discrepancies between expected and actual subscriber charging state after a change.

expected_state_snapshot.description: Expected charging state snapshot, if already available

auto_resolve.description: If true, system attempts automatic remediation where possible

functions.returns: Audit report detailing detected discrepancies, their root causes where identifiable, and any remediation actions taken or recommended.

functions.name: bulk_import_charging_changes
functions.description: Bulk-import multiple charging_changes from an upstream source with validation and idempotency keys.

mapping.description: Field mapping from source to canonical schema

functions.returns: A bulk-import job descriptor with counts of accepted, rejected, and quarantined charging_changes, plus a job_id for follow-up.

functions.name: bulk_update_charging_changes
functions.description: Apply a partial update to a batch of charging_changes matched by filter or id list.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

patch.description: Fields to patch on each matched item

functions.returns: Summary of matched, updated, and skipped charging_changes with per-item error details.

functions.name: bulk_archive_charging_changes
functions.description: Archive (soft-delete) a batch of charging_changes with retention metadata and audit reasons.
functions.returns: Per-id archive results with new lifecycle state.

functions.name: bulk_export_charging_changes
functions.description: Export a filtered set of charging_changes to a downstream destination (S3, GCS, blob, SFTP).

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Export job handle including job_id, expected object URIs, row count, and signed download URLs when applicable.

functions.name: search_charging_changes_advanced
functions.description: Advanced faceted search across charging_changes with full-text, structured filters, aggregations, and sort.

query.description: Full-text query string with Lucene-like syntax

functions.returns: Search response with charging_changes hits, total count, aggregation buckets, and a next-cursor.

functions.name: create_charging_change_subscription
functions.description: Create a subscription that fires webhooks or notifications on charging_change lifecycle events.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: The created subscription including subscription_id, active state, and last_delivery info (initially null).

functions.name: list_charging_change_subscriptions
functions.description: List existing charging_change subscriptions with optional filters and pagination.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Paginated list of subscription objects including delivery health stats.

functions.name: deactivate_charging_change_subscription
functions.description: Deactivate or delete a charging_change subscription and optionally flush pending deliveries.
functions.returns: Updated subscription state and the number of pending deliveries flushed or kept.

functions.name: get_charging_change_audit_log
functions.description: Return the audit/change log for a single charging_change with field-level diffs and actor info.

time_range.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Chronological list of audit events with before/after diffs, actor, and source IP/system.

functions.name: search_audit_events
functions.description: Search audit events across charging_changes for compliance and forensic review.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

time_range.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Paginated audit-event hits with cross-entity references.

functions.name: schedule_charging_change_job
functions.description: Create a recurring schedule that triggers a named operation on a target set of charging_changes.

operation.description: Named operation to invoke (e.g., refresh, recompute, export, reconcile)

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: The created scheduled-job descriptor with job_id, next_run_at, and current status.

functions.name: list_charging_change_jobs
functions.description: List scheduled or in-flight jobs related to charging_changes with status filtering and pagination.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Paginated list of charging_change jobs and their last run summaries.

functions.name: cancel_charging_change_job
functions.description: Cancel a scheduled or in-flight charging_change job, optionally interrupting running steps.
functions.returns: Updated job status with cancellation timestamp and any side effects.

functions.name: simulate_charging_change_change
functions.description: Simulate a proposed change against a charging_change (or batch) without committing; returns expected diffs and warnings.
functions.returns: Simulation result with predicted diffs, rule violations, cost/SLA impact, and a confidence score.

functions.name: request_charging_change_approval
functions.description: Open an approval request for a sensitive charging_change change requiring reviewer sign-off.
functions.returns: Created approval request with approval_request_id, current state, and notification targets.

functions.name: submit_charging_change_approval_decision
functions.description: Submit an approve, reject, or request-changes decision against a charging_change approval request.
functions.returns: Updated approval request state including quorum progress and final decision (if reached).

functions.name: add_charging_change_comment
functions.description: Append a comment or annotation to a charging_change, optionally attaching files or mentioning users.
functions.returns: The created comment object with comment_id, timestamps, and visibility-resolved permissions.

functions.name: list_charging_change_comments
functions.description: List comments and annotations attached to a charging_change, with optional thread expansion.
functions.returns: Paginated comment list with thread tree and attachment metadata.

functions.name: snapshot_charging_change
functions.description: Create a point-in-time immutable snapshot of a charging_change for forensic, rollback, or compliance use.
functions.returns: Snapshot descriptor with snapshot_id, checksum, byte size, and retention expiry.

functions.name: restore_charging_change_snapshot
functions.description: Restore a charging_change from a previously created snapshot, optionally as a new copy.
functions.returns: Restore job descriptor including resulting id and any per-field conflicts that were resolved.

functions.name: get_charging_change_metrics
functions.description: Compute KPI metrics over charging_changes (counts, MTTR, SLA compliance, error rates) for a time window.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

time_range.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Time-bucketed metric series and aggregate KPIs for the matched charging_changes.

functions.name: build_charging_change_dashboard
functions.description: Persist a named dashboard composed of widgets (charts, tables, single-stat) over charging_changes data.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

time_range.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Created dashboard descriptor with dashboard_id, shareable URL, and computed first-render preview.

functions.name: upsert_charging_change_policy
functions.description: Create or update a policy/rule used to govern charging_change behavior, validation, or routing.
functions.returns: Persisted policy with policy_id, version, rule count, and validation warnings (if any).

functions.name: list_charging_change_policies
functions.description: List policies governing charging_changes with version, scope, and lifecycle filters.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Paginated policy entries with rule counts and last evaluation metrics.

functions.name: link_charging_change_dependencies
functions.description: Establish or update dependency links between a charging_change and related artefacts.
functions.returns: Updated dependency graph summary with added/removed/updated edges.
